messages:
sophia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread. We captured several remediation items around GPU headroom and autoscale. I need a single-line owner, one-line ETA, and a 1-line rollback action for SRE by EOD so I can import into the action tracker.

mike: I'll take scheduler tuning + rollout plan. Scope: fairness weight sweep, preemption threshold, and small-batch enforcement. ETA: 8 business days. Rollback: revert scheduler config to last stable commit and disable new feature flag.

raj: I'll own vendor quota and sales-assisted reserved capacity. I'll open the vendor support case and loop Sales for emergency uplifts. ETA: 2 business days to file initial request. Rollback: enable reserved burst capacity and trigger region-failover routing for affected tenants.

_tess: I'll implement the staging canary and baseline dashboards. Plan: 10% internal traffic -> compare p50/p95/p99 + error rate. I'll also add a p99 alert. ETA: 3 days. Rollback: mute canary split, revert routing, and run a quick smoke A/B.

nate: I'll draft a concise emergency headroom playbook and propose a voluntary surge-night rota. Playbook will include exact console paths for autoscale/burst toggles and escalation contacts. ETA: 5 days. Rollback: documented console steps to reduce max_instances and enable throttles for low-priority lanes.

lina: I'll help instrument per-tenant backlog metrics so we can spot recurring surges early and tie alerts to tenant impact. ETA: 6 days. Rollback: none (instrumentation only) but will add runbook notes for gating.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-5201 - "Autoscale + quota follow-up: vendor request & scheduler canary" (assignee: raj). https://tracker.redwood.ai/INF-5201

mike: Canary specifics: feature-flag `sched_v2`, start internal 10% for 24h, then 10% external for 48h if stable. Measure histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) per model and tenant. If p99 increases > 15% or error rate spikes -> immediate rollback.

tess: Proposed PromQL alert (will refine):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, tenant)) > 450
```
Alert: p99 > 450ms for 10m -> page oncall and mute canary routing.

raj: Vendor path: open support ticket + submit quota form. If approval delayed > 48h, Sales to enable reserved capacity window and notify customers. I'll attach a rollback activation checklist.

nate: Runbook stub: 1) shift non-critical tenants to quantized variants; 2) bump autoscale max_instances (if quota); 3) pre-warm dedicated pool for 30m; 4) if still saturated -> enable reserved capacity via Sales + apply low-priority throttles.

sophia: TL;DR owners & ETAs for tracker: quota=raj (2d, INF-5201); scheduler=mike (8bd); canary+alert=tess (3d); runbook+nights=nate (5d); tenant metrics=lina (6d). Please paste your 1-line rollback here.

mike: rollback: revert scheduler commit + disable `sched_v2` feature flag; set max_batch_size=8.

raj: rollback: enable reserved burst capacity via Sales and route affected tenants to alternate region if vendor limits persist.

tess: rollback: mute canary traffic and switch routing back to baseline; run smoke A/B to confirm.

nate: rollback: console steps to reduce max_instances and flip throttles (will include exact CLI/Console commands in PR).

lina: added notes to instrumentation plan; no runtime rollback.

sophia: Thanks — I'll import these into the remediation tracker and create a 20-min sync for early next week to review progress. Meeting invite will include the tracker link and runbook PR once available.

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Autoscale & headroom follow-up" Mon 09:30  attendees: sophia, mike, raj, tess, nate, lina

mike: ack

raj: ack
